loom: LoomService.Weave → multi_agent.go::Weave → agent.Chat → provider/tool loop
contract: WeaveRequest query/sessionId/agentId/context; WeaveResponse text/sessionId/traceId.
state: Caches text by originating work, links returned session ID; sessions persisted by Loom; trace metadata is not retained in local cache.
error: HTTP/parse failures visible; unsent text restored. Link save is best-effort and errors swallowed.
proof: Request/response source traced; Rust live read smoke does not call Weave. No real turn executed.
gap: Context unused by backend; autonomy advisory; no current end-to-end success proof.
acceptance: Real bounded two-turn model/tool run from work, trace lookup, reload and exact owner/session readback.

loom: HTTPServer.handleStreamWeaveSSE → MultiAgentServer.StreamWeave → agent.ChatWithProgress.
contract: Custom encoding/json expects session_id/agent_id; UI receives snake_case WeaveProgress. Rust sends camelCase identity.
state: Request state/partial tool lines in Map; completion guesses session if missing; cache contains only text.
error: Failed-stage payload is treated as progress; EOF creates done; asynchronous rejection bypasses unary fallback.
proof: Go decoder probe, safe live empty-query failure, extracted current UI handler reproduction.
gap: Chosen agent/session discarded; failure can show completed; origin/trace untrustworthy.
acceptance: Choose non-default agent/session, send twice, inject execution failure/disconnect and prove actual UI/result IDs.

bridge: api.cancelLoomStream → loom_stream.rs::cancel_loom_stream → atomic flag/read wake/socket close.
loom: Loom request context cancellation; no universal arbitrary-tool pause endpoint.
contract: Frontend requestId is a local stream handle, not a durable server execution ID.
state: Active stream state cleared locally; no server acknowledgement/history reconciliation is persisted.
error: Unknown handle errors; read timeout approximately 20 s; cancelled label distinct from partial reply.
proof: Rust cancellation validation test passes. Actual running model/tool interruption was not executed.
gap: Cannot establish stopped side effects from a set flag or closed socket.
acceptance: Stop a harmless long-running counted tool, inspect backend cancellation and any subsequent side effects.

loom: multi_agent.go::AnswerClarificationQuestion → pendingQuestions answer channel.
contract: Request questionId/answer; response success/accepted/error, no status.
state: Transient card; guesses newest session if unknown; accepted server question may already be consumed.
error: Always rejects a missing status, including a genuine accepted response.
proof: Go response fixture and safe nonexistent-question HTTP-200 application rejection.
gap: Delivery acknowledgement invalid; legacy question_id versus stored request_id not separated.
acceptance: Ask/answer a real contained pending legacy question, duplicate/expire it and show exact server acknowledgement.

loom: HumanRequestStore.RespondToRequest / held-call admission; HTTP answer adapter not found.
contract: HITLRequestInfo request_id/kind/summary/context_json; store uses approved/rejected/responded states.
state: Actual hold is backend-owned; UI card is transient and does not reconcile stored decisions.
error: Legacy map returns unknown question for a store-owned ID; approval context incomplete.
proof: Independent store and RPC implementations inspected; real pending approvals untouched.
gap: Missing answer exposure is distinct from unsupported runtime holds.
acceptance: Harmless held tool: inspect reasons/args; approve once, deny once, expire and restart with authoritative state.

bridge: get/add/set_work_* in lib.rs → WorkStore; session/artifact APIs for references.
loom: No Loom WorkItem RPC; optional Loom sessions/artifacts and separate task boards.
contract: Local WorkItem active/paused, intent_id, session_id, artifact_ids and criteria.
state: work.json atomic persistence; execution/experiment relations remain frontend Maps.
error: Local persistence errors shown on mutation; some remote lists retain stale rows.
proof: Passing Rust store/inheritance/restart tests, not a live UI run.
gap: Pause is local; no runtime policy/run provenance.
acceptance: Create local work offline, attach real session/run/artifact online, restart and recover all links.

loom: No matching persistent IDE Intent API; Loom task decomposition/Weaver can consume goals separately.
contract: Local statement/why/acceptance/version/history/autonomy; context pack forwards only selected strings.
state: intents.json persists versions/history; no authoritative intent ID attached to runtime executions.
error: Validation and justification errors visible; context delivery not enforced.
proof: Local intent tests pass; no goal-to-runtime round trip.
gap: UI ONLY refers to Loom authority, not a fake local object; consequential chat need not start from intent.
acceptance: Persist intent, run against it, prove runtime context and durable evidence of that objective after restart.

loom: Runtime hooks/held requests exist; no four-level Weave policy binding or universal pause.
contract: Four shipped levels with rank/justification/inheritance; not five implemented privilege bands.
state: Local state/history persistent; in-flight runtime authority unchanged.
error: Invalid rank/raise rejected locally; no denied-execution acknowledgement.
proof: Local policy-record tests pass; executing commands do not consult policy.
gap: P0 control gap; record semantics honestly and enforce at runtime.
acceptance: Manual/paused and tightened in-flight work cannot execute forbidden operations through any entry point.

loom: ListAgents/GetAgent → runtime registry and AgentInfo.
contract: AgentInfo immutable id, name, status, counters; serde aliases/int64 conversion.
state: Refetched into frontend; registry persistence controlled by Loom configuration.
error: Listing clears on error; detail shows failure; source chooses name for chat selector although GUID is canonical.
proof: Safe live /v1/agents returns 200; actual UI identity selection not exercised.
gap: Read path real, source routing must be verified with non-default/renamed agents.
acceptance: Rename/select a contained non-default agent; verify exact GUID and real status across restart.

feature: Agents — create from reviewed JSON / description
bridge: createAgent → loom_http.rs::agent_create → POST /v1/agents; describeAgent → unary askLoom.
loom: CreateAgentFromConfig; default-agent prompt is not independent evidence of Weaver routing.
contract: CreateAgentRequest requires config/configPath; Rust sends bare editor object.
state: Dialog holds proposal; registry should persist created config according to server.
error: Server validation surfaced; normal bare request rejected.
proof: Go protojson fixture demonstrates invalid envelope; real agent not created.
gap: Creation and generated config schema do not match reviewed AgentConfig contract.
acceptance: Review valid nested config, create one actual agent, list/read/start/stop/restart it.

loom: LoomService lifecycle → pkg/server/agent_lifecycle.go.
contract: Encoded immutable agent ID in path; returned AgentInfo or lifecycle response.
state: Refreshes agents after actions; persistence/runtime effects depend on registry.
error: Action failures show notices; no live mutation/recovery test.
proof: Call chain and server implementation inspected; no real agents changed.
gap: Source wiring exists; verified lifecycle semantics cannot be inferred from list success.
acceptance: Contained create/start/stop/reload/delete and failure cases, with observed process/runtime state.

loom: Session RPCs and pkg/server/session_resume.go; resume can execute tools/models.
contract: Session/history JSON; ResumeSessionResponse and ResolveExecutionGapResponse require exact readback.
state: Selected ID/local cache; backend session store persists history; work session link is local JSON.
error: Errors shown; resume/resolve can report requested/resolved without proving effective resulting state.
proof: Real session detail parser passes; lifecycle and interrupted recovery not run.
gap: Authority/identity and restart/cancellation evidence incomplete.
acceptance: Create contained session, two turns, interrupt/resume, resolve real gap only when valid, reopen history after restart.

loom: SubscribeToSession gateway stream.
contract: Gateway newline JSON result with SessionUpdate, not SSE data lines.
state: On progress refreshes selected detail; old subscriptions not cancelled on selection change.
error: Start/error can be silent; old events are ignored but resources remain.
proof: Source transport/ownership traced; no live subscription UI test.
gap: Wrong transport plus lifecycle cleanup.
acceptance: External contained session change reaches selected UI; A→B→none leaves no subscriptions.

loom: ListAvailableModels/ListProviders → model/provider configuration.
contract: ModelInfo and ProviderEntry.config; activeProvider drives active marker.
state: Refetched in memory; backend config authoritative.
error: Errors clear unavailable detail; discovery not an effective-model execution test.
proof: Live Rust parser smoke passes model/provider responses.
gap: No provider-switch execution proof; preserve accurate unavailable/empty distinction.
acceptance: Display actual configured providers/models and verify their effective runtime selection with a contained turn.

loom: MultiAgentServer.SwitchModel → provider factory / agent role provider.
contract: Legacy request requires session_id/provider/model; agent_id defaults to default agent in implementation.
state: UI requests model only; underlying setting is agent-scoped, not independent per-session state.
error: Normal request returns missing-provider error before mutation.
proof: Live validation probe returns 400; source confirms absent provider and owner.
gap: Wrong request/target/scope; use effective model response and explicit owner.
acceptance: Switch a contained non-default session owner; read effective provider/model and prove other agents unchanged.

bridge: listTools plus loom_http.rs::tools_register; MCP per-server tool drawer.
loom: LoomService ListTools/RegisterTool subset; separate ToolRegistryService not fully exposed.
contract: RegisterToolRequest.tool; ToolDefinition schema strings; RegisterToolResponse success/message.
state: Definitions from server; register should refresh authoritative registry; not a tool implementation editor.
error: JSON/HTTP errors visible; application-success booleans require explicit validation.
proof: Live tools parser passes; no tool was registered or run.
gap: Cannot claim execution/permission integration from schemas or HTTP acceptance.
acceptance: Register a harmless actual tool in isolation; inspect schema/result and denied/failed execution, not just metadata.

loom: MCP management RPCs → pkg/server/mcp_management.go → manager/transport.
contract: Add.server envelope; Test.success/error; Health.servers map; tool schemas from Tools response.
state: Backend config/manager authoritative; UI health action can replace rows with empty list.
error: Exact Test request rejects name; latent 200 failure is parsed as server and shown passed.
proof: Safe test validation, live empty health shape and source contracts inspected.
gap: Fix each distinct envelope; do not share a server parser for test/health.
acceptance: Contained harmless MCP config test/add/list/tools/restart/delete; preserve errors and identities.

bridge: vaultInvoke → knowledge.rs CRUD/history/archive/restore; shared draft-safe editor.
loom: No Loom runtime memory API; one-way mirror exists separately.
contract: Markdown JSON frontmatter, Note/Meta, revision and original-body guards.
state: Repository-path vault; atomic journal/history preserves previous content; archive preserves files.
error: Invalid/symlink/oversize/stale writes rejected; vault errors visible.
proof: Extensive passing knowledge/store tests; no real-vault smoke performed.
gap: Local by design; does not imply model retrieval. Portable path and watcher incomplete.
acceptance: Contained local create/edit/history/archive/restore; prove only explicitly selected context reaches a real model.

loom: No GraphMemory RPC; graph is local typed relations.
contract: Nine relation types; note IDs and local positions; Obsidian JSON Canvas export.
state: Notes/edges durable; layout JSON direct write with silent catch; shared bench renderers.
error: Vault failures honest; layout failure hidden; external ledger changes missed.
proof: Graph/layout/interaction tests pass; no actual canvas screen interaction observed.
gap: Local graph useful but not runtime memory; durable layout/external signal gaps.
acceptance: Relate/drag/export/reopen actual contained notes; external edge changes refresh both surfaces.

bridge: knowledge_review / listing ledger and pending count.
loom: No Loom approval inbox; local author/proposed/evidence-link policy.
contract: Human review requires evidence edge/reason/current revision; local audit entries.
state: Vault journal and versions persist; bell derived from local listing.
error: Invalid agent overwrite/review rejected; errors visible; remote HITL not synchronized here.
proof: Passing proposal/evidence/stale-write/recovery tests.
gap: Maintain local review distinction; do not claim remote held execution approval.
acceptance: Propose/review/reject with actual linked evidence, restart, and prove it does not answer unrelated runtime holds.

loom: Loom metadata list RPCs; no model-memory write/export RPC used.
contract: Exact import markers; metadata only; existing imported IDs skipped.
state: New snapshots persisted as local notes; not updates/deletes/two-way sync; partial count reported on failure.
error: Stops with count on failure; no all-or-nothing transaction across three remote lists.
proof: Idempotent marker/content-exclusion tests pass; actual user vault not synced.
gap: Snapshots are not current runtime memory; pagination and changed/deleted remote objects not reconciled.
acceptance: Contained import twice, inspect original metadata and limitation labels, fail midway without duplicate notes.

bridge: No corresponding Tauri transport call; local graph is a different store.
loom: GraphMemoryService/MemoryLayerService gRPC contracts; configured bootstrap in Loom.
contract: Remote entity/edge/recall/remember/context/stats versus local Note/Edge.
state: Remote persistence belongs to configured Loom memory stores; no IDE synchronization.
error: No remote operation exists to return an error through this UI.
proof: Schemas/store/runtime sources inspected; remote calls not executed.
gap: UNSUPPORTED by current IDE transport, not absent from Loom. Follow existing transport decision.
acceptance: After scope/transport choice: real remember/recall/relate/context and restart with visible returned evidence.

feature: Code — files, editor and manual save
bridge: workspace commands → workspace.rs containment/read_text/write_text; Monaco editor.
loom: Local filesystem, not an agent filesystem tool API; Ask Loom sends query/context.
contract: Selected canonical root; path/content/original; UTF-8≤1 MB; explicit-save compare.
state: Files and workspace selection persist; manual dirty draft guards; no automatic agent apply/execute.
error: Outside-root/binary/read-only/external-change errors preserve draft.
proof: Passing workspace tests and frontend build; actual desktop editing not clicked.
gap: Context claims fail QC-09; no terminal/test runner promised from this local editor.
acceptance: Open/edit/save/reload contained file, detect external edit, then prove selected contextual assistance without automatic writes.

bridge: ExperimentStore status/result plus unary askLoom; selection/decision persistence.
loom: Weave agent query, not a dedicated controlled-experiment/evaluator contract.
contract: Arm config becomes prompt prose; response text saved as result; chosen arm is a human record.
state: experiments.json durable; running arms reset on client load; work relationship in Map.
error: Failure reported, local status reset handling exists; no actual tool cancellation/control enforcement.
proof: Store tests pass; no contained actual arm/evaluation run executed.
gap: Do not imply config was enforced or text independently measured; context/evidence gaps.
acceptance: Run two genuinely different supported configs, inspect tool/evaluation evidence and retain origin/decision after restart.

loom: LoomService.ABTest / provider evaluation implementation.
contract: ABTestRequest mode/providerNames; gateway result with camelCase ABTestEvent fields and int64 latency.
state: In-memory comparison table/winner; no durable work/evaluation relationship.
error: Wrong stream format discards results; empty validation error observed safely.
proof: HTTP 400 JSON envelope and source stream contracts inspected; no paid provider calls.
gap: Actual fields are flat, not oneofs; decode envelope/casing and distinguish scores from evidence.
acceptance: Compare two real contained providers, verify actual output/latency/cost/score/winner and retain evidence.

feature: Workflow catalogue, execute and execution results
bridge: list/execute/get/list-executions in lib.rs; normal workflow stream in loom_stream.rs.
loom: Workflow orchestration via MultiAgentServer → workflow engine/agents/checkpoints.
contract: ExecuteWorkflowRequest workflowRef; WorkflowProgress executionId; WorkflowExecution result/status.
state: Runtime execution authoritative; frontend polling/maps; source-work changes during run misattribute output.
error: Wrong protocol; EOF can show completed without ID; unary fallback only on command start rejection.
proof: Safe empty-request rejection; extracted origin test; no real workflow executed.
gap: Run lifecycle/error/origin/evidence not complete.
acceptance: Contained workflow success/failure/checkpoint, navigate during run, inspect real artifacts/status and restart recovery.

loom: MultiAgentServer schedule methods → workflow scheduler.
contract: ScheduleWorkflowRequest workflowName+schedule cron/timezone/enabled; cancellation is a signal, not rollback.
state: Configured backend owns schedule/history; frontend refreshes arrays.
error: HTTP errors visible; cooperative cancelled boolean/message needs effective-state readback.
proof: Live empty schedule list returns 200; no schedules created/triggered/altered.
gap: Read result does not verify cron timezone, persistence, pause/resume or interrupted execution.
acceptance: Contained schedule with explicit timezone; create/read/pause/resume/trigger/history/cancel and restart; no real-user schedule touched.

feature: Artifacts — list, View content, search and attachments
bridge: list/search/get_content → lib.rs typed metadata/content decoder; work artifact IDs saved locally.
loom: Loom artifact store APIs, actual content bytes/encoding.
contract: Artifact metadata; GetArtifactContent bytes/base64/encoding; query search; size cap.
state: Server owns artifact content; client local work attachments durable; preview/search rows transient.
error: View failures visible; list can retain stale rows; search response ordering unsafe.
proof: Decoder vectors/schema tests pass; current View/search UI existence confirmed; no private artifact contents read.
gap: Real content UI exists; need live content/provenance verification and stale-search fix.
acceptance: Produce actual contained artifact, search/open exact bytes, attach, fail content read, restart/reopen with producer evidence.

bridge: Local experiments + Loom executions; work-filter Maps; Knowledge evidence shelf reuses it.
loom: Workflow outputs and experiment records; no independent judge invocation.
contract: Observed/recorded/inferred/unknown type exists; replies do not consistently attach source/trace metadata.
state: Underlying records persist, work filter links and cached trace handles do not.
error: Unavailable lists may retain stale data; success labels depend on transport truth.
proof: Source flow traced; local result tests pass; no complete claim→evidence click chain executed.
gap: Generated narration must not be promoted to observed proof.
acceptance: Click every claim to its actual tool/test/trace/artifact, including after restart and disconnected/recovered backend.

loom: observability_rpc.go::GetTrace and runtime trace recording; process-local lookup/optional exporter.
contract: Trace/rootSpan/spans; camelCase/int64 aliases.
state: Unary reply can expose traceId; cache drops it; streaming progress does not supply authoritative trace handle.
error: Lookup errors shown in dialog; absence is not an empty verified trace.
proof: Trace parser unit tests pass; no actual execution trace inspected.
gap: Handle discovery/retention and backend retention limits need completion.
acceptance: Execute contained run, open its true span/tool context from reply/work, restart and describe available retention honestly.

bridge: iframe player ↔ LoomVault.jslib / MemoryPalaceController → host callback.
loom: No direct Loom service; host supplies real record counts/state and routes domains.
contract: Same-origin/source-checked ready/error/select; theme/state/count/size messages.
state: Queues pre-ready state/theme/count; no backend object ID selection; selected portal is local scene state.
error: Loader/Unity errors visible with Retry; Q2 fallback deferred.
proof: Bridge tests and Unity recompile pass; 4/4 asset copies match; actual WebGL/Tauri click NOT VERIFIED.
gap: Meaningful host bridge exists; no proof of current packaged navigation/render or remote memory.
acceptance: Actual Tauri six-portal selection plus real data changes, theme/motion/resize/error/retry; preserve keyboard HTML navigation.

loom: lib.rs health probe uses /v1/health; no all-server-jobs telemetry.
contract: Error/attention overrides local processing/busy/input/completed; fixed palette.
state: Transient local state; not durable execution status or remote multi-client activity.
error: False stream completion can turn it completed; error explanation belongs in text.
proof: State-priority tests pass; live semantic/UI/model comparison not executed.
gap: Keep defined meaning; distinguish observed connection from unverified whole-runtime state.
acceptance: Compare actual contained success/failure/hold/Stop/offline events against text and sphere; no fabricated activity.

bridge: get_attention derives experiment decisions; knowledge listing supplies proposed-note count.
loom: Not a complete Loom pending-request feed; runtime cards arrive only on an active stream.
contract: AttentionItem decision; finding type reserved. Local proposal count.
state: Decision records/notes persist; remote outstanding requests not enumerated/reconciled here.
error: Errors must remain distinct from zero pending; stale-signal gaps apply.
proof: Local decision/proposal tests; no remote attention inbox acceptance.
gap: Name local decisions and remote holds distinctly; preserve only actionable events.
acceptance: Real local undecided experiment and proposal plus runtime approval/error each require the right contextual action.

feature: Settings — appearance, motion, quality and connection
bridge: Theme localStorage/CSS/Monaco/player; OS motion; Unity quality; LOOM_ADDR env.
loom: No remote appearance API; server config/TLS/storage are separate settings.
contract: dark/white; High/Balanced/Low; source/origin messages; numeric socket address.
state: Appearance stored locally; quality startup queuing incomplete; connection URL display still hardcoded default.
error: Local appearance persistence failure tolerated; invalid LOOM_ADDR parse unchecked; no TLS/auth remote profile.
proof: Theme/player tests pass; actual live theme/quality pixels and remote config not verified.
gap: Keep local settings; contain connection boundary; test during-load quality and effective state.
acceptance: Toggle before/during/after player readiness; restart; invalid address surfaces an error; nonlocal profiles remain explicitly unsupported.

loom: LoomService pattern RPCs → pattern library/hot reload.
contract: Patterns/detail JSON and load/create responses; gateway stream update event.
state: Backend files/library authoritative; shelf refreshes in memory.
error: List/detail errors shown; realtime update format wrong.
proof: Safe live patterns list 200; mutations not run.
gap: Shelf real; automatic updates and contextual use/evidence need live verification.
acceptance: Contained actual pattern create/load/read and external update reflected in shelf; prove a run uses chosen pattern where supported.

loom: SkillsImportService → skills importer/router rebuild, separate service registration.
contract: InlineSkill SKILL.md/references; BulkImportSkillsRequest srcDir/outDir; progress/routerReloaded.
state: Backend generated skill tree durable; no list RPC promised; progress UI local.
error: Unavailable service can reject routes; gateway stream wrong; per-skill failure must not become finished-success.
proof: Schemas/handler inspected; no private skills imported or dependencies added.
gap: HTTP annotation is not exposure; actual model-loaded skill must be proven.
acceptance: Contained genuine skill import/classify, router reload/read/use in run, partial-failure and restart behavior.

bridge: loom_tasks.rs 19-style command surface; task_updates_stream; JSON dialogs/actions.

contract: Nested task/update/dependency envelopes; readyTasks/blockedTasks; status enums and limits.

error: Current live routes 404; latent update/list-shape defects; generic Value can fabricate response-object row.
proof: Live board/task 404; inspected task methods/proto; no real board mutated.

acceptance: Contained board/task create/update/claim/release/transition/dependency/decompose; conflict tests and exact readback after restart.

bridge: apps list/get/create/update/delete/components → loom_http.rs; open backend app route.

contract: CreateUIAppRequest.spec, metadata/content response; UI instead posts name/html.
state: Server app provider controls persistence; list refreshed after mutations.
error: Normal create rejected unknown html; rendered app path/runtime compiler not exercised.
proof: Safe live create validation rejects before any write; actual apps not created/opened/deleted.

feature: Server configuration, TLS and storage administration

feature: Menus, search, drawers and keyboard paths
bridge: installAppMenu, existing workspace/knowledge actions and scoped searches.
